To: Sonder (London) – Host of Airbnb listing ID 1102122537966447798, located in Kensington and Chelsea, London.  
Pursuant to the Deregulation Act 2015, Section 44, which caps short‑term lets in the London borough of Kensington and Chelsea at 90 nights per calendar year, and the Housing Act 2004 (relevant provisions on unlicensed House in Multiple Occupation), you have exceeded the legal limit by 165 nights, having been booked for an estimated 255 nights over the preceding 365‑day period. This breach constitutes an unlawful operation of a short‑term let and is subject to enforcement action under the Council’s housing enforcement powers. You are hereby required to cease all short‑term letting activities at the aforementioned property with immediate effect and to regularise the letting in accordance with the statutory limits, or face further legal proceedings.

The Airbnb listing (ID 1102122537966447798) operated by Sonder (London) in Kensington and Chelsea has been active for an estimated 255 nights in the last 365 days, surpassing the statutory 90‑night cap by 165 nights. The operator manages only one property, yet the algorithmic confidence score indicates a 97% likelihood that the listing is non‑compliant with the Deregulation Act 2015 short‑term let restrictions. This evidence satisfies the Council’s threshold for enforcement under both the Deregulation Act 2015 (s.44) and the Housing Act 2004.

Prosecution
